derived.uniformHiddenThresholdFormula: baseRtp + alpha*x/(boundary-x) = 1, where alpha is Mini meter funding per EUR network wager and x is current/award amount
derived.interpretation: If and only if a hidden threshold were uniformly distributed over the surviving interval and threshold ownership were proportional to meter contribution, break-even would be about EUR181.92. This is a sensitivity benchmark only.

criticalWarning: No Playtech-specific evidence currently binds PowerPlay to a uniform hidden-threshold architecture. Public must-hit-by systems can also use state-dependent per-spin hazard. The observed EUR172 Mini award proves awards occur below the EUR200 boundary and invalidates treating EUR200 as the guaranteed payout amount for entry-EV calculations.
